text:
maria_sales: Heads up — FinAI wants a POC with strict EU + APAC data residency, BYOK (customer-managed KMS in EU), and region pinning for low latency. They expect ~500 RPS sustained during the POC. Can we guarantee capacity and what changes pricing/timeline? cc @sam_eng @natalie_sec @ryan_sre
sam_eng: We can pin a tenant to eu-west-1 and asia-southeast-1 but guarantees require Dedicated (reserved capacity). Hosted regional endpoints route traffic to those regions but don’t provide hard RPS SLAs unless you commit capacity. For 500 RPS sustained, Dedicated or Private is the safe path.
ryan_sre: Rough infra note — sustained 500 RPS for gen-heavy workloads ~= 3–4 GPU nodes worth of A10-equivalent per region (depends on model + sequence length). If they’re using Redwood Optimize (prefix caching + batching) we can reduce counts. Procurement + infra prep in APAC typically 2–4 weeks; EU is faster if we already have pool.
natalie_sec: BYOK is doable. Customer must provision the KMS key (ARN) in their project/tenant and allow our service principal minimal encrypt/decrypt permissions. We’ll also need to confirm HSM vs cloud-KMS expectations for keys at rest and audit log export. Please route RSA/ISO certs to the customer; legal_ops will need to add the cloud provider to the subprocessor list for contractual purposes.
maria_sales: Quick pricing Q: what’s delta between hosted (regioned) vs dedicated commit for this scale? Any one-time onboarding fees we should flag?
sam_eng: Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated reserved infra for two regions supporting 500 RPS each might run in the high tens of thousands/month (~$45k–$75k/mo depending on model size and quantization). Hosted regioned endpoints without capacity guarantees could be ~30–50% cheaper but no SLA. Onboarding & security integration (BYOK, SSO, subproc attestation) usually carries a one-time services fee — estimate $8k–$12k. I’ll send a detailed calc once we pick model + sequence assumptions.
ryan_sre: Ops recommendation: enable KV/prefix caching and workload-aware batching for the POC — it cuts token costs and GPU requirements by ~30–50% on generator workloads. We can run a perf sim if the customer provides sample traces (qps, avg tokens).
maria_sales: I’ll ask FinAI for sample traces and the KMS ARNs. Also they asked for current subprocessor list for EU & APAC — can someone paste the up-to-date list?
vendor_bot: Subprocessor snapshot: AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (asia-southeast1), Cloudflare (global edge), HashiCorp Vault (regional), ObservableStorageProvider — see /docs/subprocessors for versions and attestations.
natalie_sec: Also note: enterprise legal wants an EU-only clause for data export controls and a BYOK handling addendum. legal_ops will prepare a redline and vendor attestation. We’ll need to complete their security questionnaire (SOC2/ISO attachments).
legal_ops: We’ll start drafting the redline today. maria_sales — can you confirm the customer’s legal contact and which regulatory frameworks (GDPR + APAC country specifics) to highlight?
maria_sales: Contact is legal@finai.com, point person is Claire Wong. They mentioned GDPR + Singapore PDPA. I’ll share contact and ask for a sample security questionnaire.
atalie_sec: If they require HSM isolation (customer HSM), escalate asap; that adds complexity. Otherwise standard KMS BYOK flow is straightforward.
ryan_sre: Timeline: if customer provides KMS ARNs + sample traffic by EOD Monday, we can attempt a hosted-region soft-start in ~3 weeks and run canary traffic. Dedicated reserved capacity would likely push full POC start to 4–6 weeks (procurement and infra config). Hybrid approach (start hosted-regioned + parallel dedicated onboarding) is feasible and reduces risk.
maria_sales: Perfect — I’ll propose the hybrid path and the services/onboarding estimate. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sam_eng: I’ll prep the model/throughput estimation template. maria_sales — drop their expected token distribution and model family when you have it.
maria_sales: Will do. Follow-ups: I’ll send Claire the questionnaire request and propose timeline.
ryan_sre: ping me once you have sample traces, I’ll queue a perf run.
atalie_sec: I’ll queue the security questionnaire review.
legal_ops: We’ll aim to have draft redline in 48h after we get the questionnaire.
maria_sales: Great — closing for now, will update thread with customer artifacts. Thanks everyone.
